newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's BIAT has 4.28 mln dnrs H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's BIAT has 4.28 mln dnrs H1 net.

text.p: Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie (BIAT), the third largest bank in Tunisia, on Tuesday said its net profits for the first half of 1996 amounted to 4.276 million dinars.
Figures for the same period last year were not available for comparison.
BIAT posted a 9.63 million dinars net profits for 1995, from 8.62 million dinars in 1994.
BIAT, owned by a majority of Tunisian private shareholders, has a capital of 60 million dinars.

Other shareholders include Italy's San Paolo Bank Holding, Morocco's Wafa Bank, Saudi's National Commercial Bank of Jeddah, France's Societe Marseillaise de Credit and Caisse Centrale des Banques Populaires, and Kuwait's Al Ahli Bank and Bank of Kuwait and the Middle East. ($=0.96 dinar)
